∀ (q : OracleTemplate.Muon.Public) (N : ℕ),
  outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.randomMuon q N =
    { Seed := Fin (N + 1), seedSpace := Fin.instMeasurableSpace (N + 1),
      law := ⟨(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (N + 1))).toMeasure, ⋯⟩, State := OracleTemplate.Muon.State q × Fin (N + 1),
      initial := fun j => ((OracleTemplate.Muon.muon q).initial 1 (), j),
      query := fun st => (OracleTemplate.Muon.muon q).query 1 st.1,
      update := fun st G => ((OracleTemplate.Muon.muon q).update 1 st.1 G, st.2),
      output := fun st => st.1.iterates ↑st.2 }
